title: No More Refugees, Trump Said. Except White South Africans.

sentences.en: 33 presidents.

sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: For decades, white South Africans ruled with an iron fist, overseeing the country's cruel system of racial oppression.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，南非白人以铁腕统治，监管着该国残酷的种族压迫制度。

sentences.en: So why is President Trump now welcoming them to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么特朗普总统现在欢迎他们作为受害者来到美国呢？

sentences.en: as victims?
sentences.zh: 作为受害者？

sentences.en: Today, John Eligo on how the MAGA movement became obsessed with Afrikaners.
sentences.zh: 今天，约翰·埃利戈将讲述“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）运动是如何迷上南非白人的。

sentences.en: It's Monday, May 19th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月19日，星期一。

sentences.en: John, welcome back to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 约翰，欢迎回到《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Hi, good to be here.
sentences.zh: 你好，很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: I don't know if you remember this, but the last time we spoke was four years ago, almost to the month,
sentences.zh: 不知道你还记不记得，我们上次交谈是在四年前，几乎就在同一个月，

sentences.en: because in the middle of the interview, my wife began to give birth to our son.
sentences.zh: 因为在采访进行到一半时，我妻子开始分娩我们的儿子了。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: She went into labor, and we did not finish the conversation.
sentences.zh: 她开始阵痛，我们没能完成那次谈话。

sentences.en: Well, hopefully we don't have that problem again this time.
sentences.zh: 好吧，希望这次我们不会再遇到那种问题了。

sentences.en: No, no, no chance.
sentences.zh: 不，不，绝对不会。

sentences.en: So, on to the topic at hand.
sentences.zh: 那么，回到正题。

sentences.en: John, since taking office, the Trump administration has really systematically shut down the programs that designate and bring refugees into the United States from around the world.
sentences.zh: 约翰，特朗普政府自上任以来，确实系统性地关闭了那些指定并接收来自世界各地难民进入美国的项目。

sentences.en: And then, a few days ago, the White House made a pretty big exception to that.
sentences.zh: 然后，几天前，白宫对此做出了一个相当大的例外处理。

sentences.en: But I want you to just start with the shutting down process for just a moment.
sentences.zh: 但我希望你先从关闭这些项目的过程谈起。

sentences.en: Yeah, so essentially, when Trump came into office, we know he had this flurry of executive orders that he signed.
sentences.zh: 好的，本质上，当特朗普上任时，我们知道他签署了一系列行政命令。

sentences.en: And among those executive orders was an order that essentially suspended the refugee program.
sentences.zh: 在这些行政命令中，有一项基本上暂停了难民项目。

sentences.en: So, this is essentially the program where you have people who are in war-torn places like Sudan, where we've been driven from Sudan.
sentences.zh: 所以，这基本上就是那个项目，接收来自苏丹等战乱地区的人们，我们的人曾被赶出苏丹。

sentences.en: People in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where there's an ongoing war for decades now.
sentences.zh: 还有刚果民主共和国的人，那里几十年来一直战火不断。

sentences.en: Now, tens of thousands of Afghans who had been approved, they had been screened, and they'd been ready to come over to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在，成千上万的阿富汗人已经获得了批准，经过了审查，准备好前往美国，

sentences.en: to be resettled.
sentences.zh: 进行安置。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But by suspending the program, you essentially stop all that.
sentences.zh: 但通过暂停该项目，你基本上阻止了这一切。

sentences.en: And can you remind us what President Trump's rationale was for doing that?
sentences.zh: 你能提醒我们特朗普总统这样做的理由是什么吗？

sentences.en: His broad rationale is that, hey, this is something that threatens the interests of the
sentences.zh: 他大体上的理由是，嘿，这会威胁到美国的利益。

sentences.en: United States.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们谈到过，引入未经过适当安全审查的难民可能会进入国内并危害国家。

sentences.en: So, they've talked about how bringing in refugees who are not properly vetted for security reasons could come in and harm the country.
sentences.zh: 还有关于这在经济上会对国家造成什么影响的讨论，认为国家可能会被外国人拖累和压垮，这反而会阻碍国家发展，而不是帮助它。

sentences.en: And there's also been talk about economically what it could do to the country, that the country could be overburdened and overwhelmed with foreigners, and that can really hamper
sentences.zh: 而不是帮助它。

sentences.en: the country rather than help it.
sentences.zh: 而不是帮助它。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think that brings us to this very surprising scene we saw just a few days ago.
sentences.zh: 我想这就引出了我们几天前看到的那个非常令人惊讶的场景。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, even though Trump suspended this refugee program...
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管特朗普暂停了这个难民项目……

sentences.en: It is such an honor for us to receive you here today.
sentences.zh: 今天能在这里接待你们，我们深感荣幸。

sentences.en: This is the land of the free.
sentences.zh: 这是自由之地。

sentences.en: We had dozens of refugees arriving at Dulles Airport, and they certainly did not look like all of those who'd been suspended from coming.
sentences.zh: 我们有几十名难民抵达杜勒斯机场，他们看起来肯定不像所有那些被禁止入境的人。

sentences.en: I know you've gone through a long flight.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们经历了一次漫长的飞行。

sentences.en: I cannot believe there are babies and children who are actually so well-behaved.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信竟然有这么乖巧的婴儿和孩子。

sentences.en: This is much better than mine.
sentences.zh: 这比我家的好多了。

sentences.en: So, these were white South Africans, specifically Afrikaners, who are an ethnic minority in South
sentences.zh: 所以，这些是南非白人，具体来说是阿非利卡人，他们是南非的一个少数族裔。

sentences.en: Africa.
sentences.zh: 南非。

sentences.en: Many of us, our families, have had a journey not that different from the journey that you are embarking on today.
sentences.zh: 我们许多人的家庭，所经历的旅程与你们今天即将踏上的旅程并无二致。

sentences.en: My own father was born in Europe and had to leave his country.
sentences.zh: 我父亲本人出生在欧洲，不得不离开他的国家。

sentences.en: They had a lot of luggage, you know, all their belongings.
sentences.zh: 他们带了很多行李，你知道，所有的家当。

sentences.en: They came into an airport hangar, and they were given this big reception by some of the top officials in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们进入了一个机场机库，受到了美国政府一些高层官员的隆重接待，欢迎他们来到这里。

sentences.en: government welcoming them here.
sentences.zh: 政府欢迎他们来到这里。

sentences.en: Personally, we look forward, too, after this, to be able to spend a little bit of time with you and get to talk to you guys.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言，我们也很期待在此之后能花点时间和你们在一起，和你们聊聊。

sentences.en: So, thank you, guys.
sentences.zh: 所以，谢谢你们。

sentences.en: So, about a month after Trump signed that executive order suspending the refugee program, he signed
sentences.zh: 所以，在特朗普签署那项暂停难民项目的行政命令大约一个月后，他又签署了

sentences.en: another executive order that essentially allowed this group of Afrikaners to come to the United States as refugees.
sentences.zh: 另一项行政命令，基本上允许这群阿非利卡人作为难民来到美国。

sentences.en: So, essentially, what Trump was saying was that they can open the refugee program for this small group of white South Africans, but them alone.
sentences.zh: 所以，本质上，特朗普的意思是，他们可以为这小群南非白人开放难民项目，但仅限他们。

sentences.en: So, what's the story of how this group of white South Africans somehow becomes the single exception to President Trump's deeply skeptical relationship to refugees?
sentences.zh: 那么，这群南非白人是如何成为特朗普总统对难民深表怀疑的态度下的唯一例外的呢？

sentences.en: The one group that gets through.
sentences.zh: 唯一获准进入的群体。

sentences.en: Well, let me tell you a little bit about the Afrikaners, Michael, because it goes back a long way.
sentences.zh: 好吧，迈克尔，让我给你讲讲阿非利卡人的故事，因为这由来已久。

sentences.en: So, back in 1652, Jan van Riebeek was a Dutch settler who sort of started the colonial settlement of what's now South Africa.
sentences.zh: 早在1652年，扬·范里贝克是一位荷兰定居者，他开启了现在南非的殖民定居。

sentences.en: And over time, these Dutch settlers, as well as other settlers from Germany, from France, and other parts of Europe would come in.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，这些荷兰定居者，以及来自德国、法国和欧洲其他地方的定居者陆续到来。

sentences.en: And out of that would sort of arise this new ethnicity called Afrikaners, which is a mix of these various, you know, European settlers who came in and settled there.
sentences.zh: 由此产生了一种新的族群，叫做阿非利卡人，他们是这些来到这里定居的各种欧洲定居者的混合体。

sentences.en: And pretty early on, you know, with the locals who were already in South Africa at the time, there were clashes, right?
sentences.zh: 很早的时候，你知道，与当时已经在南非的当地人之间就发生了冲突，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, there were fights over land.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，为了土地发生了争斗。

sentences.en: There were struggles and tensions.
sentences.zh: 充满了挣扎和紧张局势。

sentences.en: And the story gets even more complicated over the years as the British come to South
sentences.zh: 随着英国人来到南非，这个故事变得更加复杂了，对吧？

sentences.en: Africa, right?
sentences.zh: 南非，对吧？

sentences.en: And while the British took a lot of the economic power in the country, the Afrikaners amassed political power.
sentences.zh: 虽然英国人掌握了该国大部分的经济权力，但阿非利卡人积累了政治权力。

sentences.en: And so then came elections in 1948, which black people were not allowed to participate in.
sentences.zh: 于是就有了1948年的选举，黑人是不被允许参加的。

sentences.en: And in that election, an Afrikaner-led party won control of the government.
sentences.zh: 在那次选举中，一个由阿非利卡人领导的政党赢得了政府控制权。

sentences.en: And once they took power, they created a system that we all know today, that system of apartheid.
sentences.zh: 一旦他们掌权，他们就建立了一个我们今天都知道的制度，即种族隔离制度。

sentences.en: So Afrikaners end up becoming the group that enforces the really brutal rules of segregation that come to define South Africa.
sentences.zh: 所以阿非利卡人最终成为了执行那些定义南非的残酷种族隔离规则的群体。

sentences.en: Yes, Michael.
sentences.zh: 是的，迈克尔。

sentences.en: So they essentially formed this government that relegates black South Africans, the majority population, to essentially subhuman status.
sentences.zh: 所以他们基本上组建了这个政府，将占多数人口的南非黑人降至基本上非人的地位。

sentences.en: They kick them off their land.
sentences.zh: 他们把他们从土地上赶走。

sentences.en: They force them to live in these ramshackle townships that got no resources, oftentimes didn't have water or electricity or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 他们强迫他们住在那些破烂不堪的城镇里，那里没有资源，通常没有水、电或类似的东西。

sentences.en: Their movements, the movements of the black majority, were very tightly controlled.
sentences.zh: 他们的行动，黑人多数派的行动，受到了非常严格的控制。

sentences.en: They needed special passes if they wanted to go into cities or towns.
sentences.zh: 如果他们想进入城市或城镇，需要特别通行证。

sentences.en: The areas with the most arable farmland, those were not areas where black people were allowed to settle.
sentences.zh: 拥有最肥沃农田的地区，不是黑人被允许定居的地区。

sentences.en: Those were areas that the white population was able to take over.
sentences.zh: 那些是白人人口能够接管的地区。

sentences.en: And this system ruled for nearly 50 years until the early 1990s, when you started to see much of the world turn against the system.
sentences.zh: 这个制度统治了近50年，直到20世纪90年代初，你开始看到世界上大部分地区开始反对这个制度。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And you started to see this sort of crumble, and the Afrikaners had to sort of give way to the black majority.
sentences.zh: 你开始看到它开始瓦解，阿非利卡人不得不向黑人多数派让步。

sentences.en: And what does that look like for the Afrikaners who have amassed so much power to have to give it up?
sentences.zh: 对于积累了如此多权力的阿非利卡人来说，不得不放弃权力是什么感觉？

sentences.en: So, toward the end of the apartheid system, there were vigorous negotiations over what the Afrikaners would give up, what they would keep, and what black people would get.
sentences.zh: 所以，在种族隔离制度末期，关于阿非利卡人将放弃什么、保留什么以及黑人将得到什么，进行了激烈的谈判。

sentences.en: And essentially, what was negotiated at the time was a system in which black people would get their political power.
sentences.zh: 本质上，当时谈判达成的是一个黑人将获得政治权力的制度。

sentences.en: However, but through those negotiations, Afrikaners were not really forced to give up their economic status.
sentences.zh: 然而，通过这些谈判，阿非利卡人并没有真正被迫放弃他们的经济地位。

sentences.en: They were not forced to give up land.
sentences.zh: 他们没有被迫放弃土地。

sentences.en: Essentially, it was a relatively peaceful transition.
sentences.zh: 本质上，这是一个相对和平的过渡。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: It sounds like they're treated surprisingly well, given the circumstances of what they had inflicted on the majority that's now suddenly in power.
sentences.zh: 考虑到他们对现在突然掌权的多数派所施加的一切，他们受到的待遇出奇地好。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And to this day in South Africa, you will hear one of the big criticisms about Nelson Mandela,
sentences.zh: 直到今天在南非，你还会听到对纳尔逊·曼德拉的一大批评，

sentences.en: who was the hero of the anti-apartheid movement, as much of the world knows him, is that he did
sentences.zh: 正如全世界所知，他是反种族隔离运动的英雄，批评在于他并没有

sentences.en: not do enough to aggressively force a change, that you essentially had the system where a small
sentences.zh: 做足够多的努力来强力推动变革，本质上你拥有这样一个制度：一小部分

sentences.en: percentage of white people held most of the wealth, where you had this large population of black people who were still in poverty and did not have much wealth at all.
sentences.zh: 白人掌握了大部分财富，而你拥有大量仍然处于贫困中、几乎没有任何财富的黑人人口。

sentences.en: Even after apartheid.
sentences.zh: 即使在种族隔离结束后也是如此。

sentences.en: Exactly, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: And Mandela's whole thing was that he wanted to avoid a civil war.
sentences.zh: 曼德拉的全部理念是他想避免内战。

sentences.en: He wanted to build a country in which everyone could coexist alongside each other, right?
sentences.zh: 他想建立一个每个人都能共存的国家，对吧？

sentences.en: So you had this transition where the idea was that you sort of allow everyone to have their own piece of society.
sentences.zh: 所以你经历了这样一个过渡，其理念是让每个人都能在社会中拥有自己的一席之地。

sentences.en: Now, from the beginning, you had this great fear among white South Africans, right?
sentences.zh: 从一开始，南非白人中就存在这种巨大的恐惧，对吧？

sentences.en: That things would go horribly wrong, that they would be hunted in the streets and that they
sentences.zh: 担心事情会变得极其糟糕，担心他们会在街头被猎杀，担心他们

sentences.en: would have to, you know, migrate, you know, run out of the country and leave very quickly.
sentences.zh: 不得不，你知道，移民，你知道，迅速逃离这个国家。

sentences.en: And you did indeed have white South Africans who left the country, but there was no mass confiscation of white-owned land.
sentences.zh: 确实有南非白人离开了这个国家，但并没有发生大规模没收白人土地的情况。

sentences.en: There was no mass firing of white people.
sentences.zh: 没有发生大规模解雇白人的情况。

sentences.en: That never happened.
sentences.zh: 那从未发生过。

sentences.en: So how do these Afrikaners, who are largely being spared major dislocation and change, how do they ever qualify as refugees in the eyes of the United States?
sentences.zh: 那么，这些在很大程度上免于重大动荡和变革的阿非利卡人，是如何在美国眼中获得难民资格的呢？

sentences.en: They seem like the exact opposite so far in the story of refugees.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，在难民的故事中，他们看起来完全相反。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think you have to look at what it's like to give up power, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，我想你必须看看放弃权力是什么感觉，对吧？

sentences.en: So you have, yes, Mandela is framing it as, you know, building a nation together.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，曼德拉将其定义为，你知道，共同建设一个国家。

sentences.en: But part of that is having to do practical things in order to ensure that a population, the black majority, had access to opportunities that they didn't have before.
sentences.zh: 但其中一部分是必须做一些实际的事情，以确保人口，即黑人多数派，能够获得他们以前没有的机会。

sentences.en: So that meant looking at things like affirmative action to ensure that companies are hiring black people.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要考虑诸如平权行动之类的事情，以确保公司雇佣黑人。

sentences.en: And then there was, of course, the issue of land.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有土地问题。

sentences.en: And this is one in which the government tried to say to the white landowners who owned almost
sentences.zh: 这是一个政府试图对拥有几乎所有土地的白人地主说的问题，嘿，如果你能给我们一些土地，我们会付钱给你，这样我们就可以重新分配

sentences.en: all of the land, hey, we'll pay you if you can give us some of that land so we can redistribute
sentences.zh: 它给我们的黑人人口，给那些在土地上工作和生活多年但从未有机会拥有它的人。

sentences.en: it to our black population, to people who've worked on the land and lived on the land for years but never got a chance to own it.
sentences.zh: 所以这被称为“自愿买家，自愿卖家”计划。

sentences.en: So it was called a willing buyer, willing seller program.
sentences.zh: 那么阿非利卡人最终有多愿意出售土地呢？

sentences.en: And how much do the Afrikaners end up being willing to sell the land?
sentences.zh: 确实有一定程度的出售，但远没有我认为政府想要的那么多。

sentences.en: There was a degree of selling, but not nearly as much as I think the government wanted.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，你就会看到这一点。

sentences.en: And so you take that over time.
sentences.zh: 你所看到的是，围绕土地出现了一些冲突点。

sentences.en: And what you see is that there's these flashpoints happening around land.
sentences.zh: 那么其中一些冲突点是什么？

sentences.en: And what are some of those flashpoints?

sentences.zh: 因为我们一直在谈论的所有其他事情？

sentences.en: Which he means white Afrikaners.
sentences.zh: 而在多大程度上，它关乎美国国内的情况，即针对这里白人公民的所谓威胁程度？

sentences.en: They happen to be white.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这到底是关于阿非利卡人的故事，还是特朗普及其周围的人认为它对美国白人所代表的那个警示故事？

sentences.en: But whether they're white or black makes no difference to me.
sentences.zh: 还是两者兼有？

sentences.en: But white farmers are being brutally killed and their land is being confiscated in South Africa.
sentences.zh: 我认为从大多数客观标准来看，南非实地的真相与特朗普描述的阿非利卡人处境并不相符。

sentences.en: He also calls them the victims of, quote, unjust racial discrimination.
sentences.zh: 显然，正如我们所说，确实存在阿非利卡人被杀害的案例。

sentences.en: So what this does is essentially it opens up a pathway now for refugee status, for someone to come to the U.S.'s refugees.
sentences.zh: 而且我相信，在我交谈过的许多阿非利卡人中，有一种真诚的看法，认为他们是被针对的，他们受到了不公平的对待。

sentences.en: And in this case, it's specifically Afrikaners who can come to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们中的许多人确实有这种真诚的信念。

sentences.en: as refugees.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，当你审视特朗普对这个问题的关注时，它似乎很大程度上是由美国国内的情况所驱动的。

sentences.en: So after he signs this executive order, this effort to get Afrikaners in America, it proceeded with stunning speed.
sentences.zh: 如果你听听特朗普阵营的人怎么说……

sentences.en: Usually it takes years to get refugees into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们被要求假装这没有发生，但它确实在发生。

sentences.en: But three months after this executive order is issued,
sentences.zh: 每个人都讨厌白人，希望他们去死。

sentences.en: we have the first Afrikaner refugees, 59 of them, lined up at the airport in Johannesburg, waiting to get on a flight to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这从何而来？

sentences.en: John, the inevitable question here would seem to be how much has this decision by the president
sentences.zh: 有一种坚定的信念，认为南非代表了美国最糟糕的噩梦。

sentences.en: and those around him truly been about the circumstances of Afrikaners in South Africa and the threat level against them because of this land law,
sentences.zh: DEI（多元、公平与包容）把美国变成了一个露天监狱，如果你是白人，你就永远无法逃脱。

sentences.en: because of everything else we've been talking about?
sentences.zh: 你必须不断道歉。

sentences.en: And how much has it been about circumstances within the United States, the perceived threat level against white citizens here?
sentences.zh: 就像是，顺便说一句，如果你想生活在那样的国家，就去南非吧。

sentences.en: In other words, is this about the tale of the Afrikaners or that cautionary tale that Trump and those around him feel it represents to white Americans?
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人会指着南非说：

sentences.en: Or is it both?
sentences.zh: 如果我们任由这些多元、公平与包容政策泛滥，南非就是美国未来会变成什么样子的例子。

sentences.en: I think by most objective measures, the facts on the ground in South Africa do not match up with the way Trump has described the situation there for Afrikaners.
sentences.zh: 走上这条不道德的道路，最终不可避免地会让你陷入一个境地，虽然南非还没有完全到达那里，但他们已经在路上了。

sentences.en: Obviously, there are cases, like we've said, where Afrikaners are killed.
sentences.zh: 而那条道路最终是一条充满怪诞、种族灭绝暴力的道路。

sentences.en: And there is a sincere perception, I believe, among many Afrikaners I've spoken with, that they are targeted, that they are treated unfairly.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过针对南非，特朗普为他在美国的选民基础赢得了分数，这些选民非常反感任何形式的法律措施或任何倡议，

sentences.en: That is a sincere belief that I think a lot of them do have.
sentences.zh: 哪怕只是有一点点试图以某种方式解决种族不公正的苗头，只要这看起来像是对白人的歧视。

sentences.en: That said, when you look at Trump's attention to this issue, it seems very much motivated by domestic circumstances in America.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，在特朗普政府内部，这是否感觉像是将他们一直坚持的国内价值观——就像你说的，在政府甚至私营部门撤回多元化倡议——置于美国外交政策的核心，

sentences.en: If you listen to people in Trump's orbit...
sentences.zh: 并声称如果这要成为我们处理国内政策的核心，那么这也将成为我们处理世界各地关系的核心。

sentences.en: We're required to pretend this isn't happening, but it is happening.
sentences.zh: 我们被要求假装这一切没有发生，但它确实正在发生。

sentences.en: Everybody hates the whites and wants them to die.
sentences.zh: 每个人都憎恨白人，并希望他们去死。

sentences.en: Where does that come from?
sentences.zh: 这种想法从何而来？

sentences.en: There's a firm belief that South Africa represents sort of the worst nightmare for America.
sentences.zh: 有一种坚定的信念认为，南非代表了美国某种意义上最糟糕的噩梦。

sentences.en: DEI creates America into an open-air prison that if you're white, you can never escape it.
sentences.zh: DEI（多元、公平与包容）把美国变成了一座露天监狱，如果你是白人，你永远无法逃脱。

sentences.en: You have to constantly apologize.
sentences.zh: 你必须不断地道歉。

sentences.en: And it's like, by the way, if you want to live in that type of country, go to South Africa.
sentences.zh: 而且就像是说，顺便提一下，如果你想生活在那样的国家，那就去南非吧。

sentences.en: Many of them will point to South Africa and say,
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人会指向南非并说，

sentences.en: South Africa is the example of what America will become if we allow these diversity, equity, and inclusion policies to just run rampant.
sentences.zh: 南非就是如果我们任由这些多元、公平与包容政策横行，美国将会变成什么的例子。

sentences.en: To go down this immoral path will inevitably end you in a place where they're not yet arrived in South Africa, but they're well on their way.
sentences.zh: 走上这条不道德的道路，最终必然会将你带到一个地方，虽然南非还没完全到达那里，但他们已经在路上了。

sentences.en: And that path ultimately is a path of grotesque, genocidal violence.
sentences.zh: 而那条道路最终是一条充满怪诞、种族灭绝暴力的道路。

sentences.en: So, by targeting South Africa, Trump builds points with his base in the U.S., which very much frowns upon any sort of legal measure or any sort of initiatives
sentences.zh: 因此，通过针对南非，特朗普在支持者中赢得了分数，因为他的基本盘非常反感任何形式的法律措施或倡议，

sentences.en: that even have a whiff of trying to address racial injustice in a way that makes it seem like it's discriminating against white people.
sentences.zh: 只要这些措施稍微带有一点试图解决种族不公的意味，且看起来像是对白人进行歧视，他们就会反对。

sentences.en: I wonder if, within the Trump administration, this feels akin to taking their domestic values, which they have been very firm about, like you said,
sentences.zh: 我想知道，在特朗普政府内部，这是否类似于将他们一直坚持的国内价值观——正如你所说，

sentences.en: rolling back diversity initiatives across government and even the private sector, and putting those now at the center of U.S.
sentences.zh: 在政府甚至私营部门撤回多元化倡议——现在将其置于美国外交政策的核心，

sentences.en: foreign policy, and saying if this is going to be central to how we treat domestic policy, this will be central to how we treat our relationships across the world.
sentences.zh: 并宣称如果这将成为我们处理国内政策的核心，那么它也将成为我们处理世界各地关系的核心。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国。

sentences.en: government, Trump's administration, has said that explicitly, that they were cutting funding for programs that they believe further these issues of DEI,
sentences.zh: 政府，即特朗普政府，已经明确表示，他们正在削减那些他们认为助长了DEI问题的项目的资金，

sentences.en: you know, diversity, equity, and inclusion.
sentences.zh: 也就是多元化、公平和包容性。

sentences.en: So, undoubtedly, what you're saying, Michael, is the case in terms of that they are sort of putting their own judgment and their own values
sentences.zh: 所以，迈克尔，毫无疑问，你说的情况确实存在，他们某种程度上是在用自己的判断和价值观，

sentences.en: on what they see is happening in South Africa.
sentences.zh: 来衡量他们所看到的南非正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: And I'll also note, when you talk to South Africans, you know, whether that be government officials or, in just some case, ordinary South Africans,
sentences.zh: 我还要指出，当你与南非人交谈时，无论是政府官员，还是在某些情况下，普通的南非人，

sentences.en: that, for them, is what feels like a frustrating thing, is that even if you want to accept that in America,
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，令人沮丧的是，即使你想承认在美国，

sentences.en: maybe some of these initiatives, these laws and policies don't stack up.
sentences.zh: 也许其中一些倡议、法律和政策并不适用。

sentences.en: They're saying, look, we have our own unique history here, a history where most people still have a living memory of apartheid because it's only 31 years ago.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，看，我们这里有自己独特的历史，大多数人对种族隔离制度仍有切身记忆，因为那仅仅是31年前的事。

sentences.en: That legacy is so baked in here that we clearly have to do things to change that and that we also have a majority Black population, an 80% Black population
sentences.zh: 那种遗留问题在这里根深蒂固，我们显然必须采取行动来改变它，而且我们还有占人口80%的黑人多数群体，

sentences.en: that continues to struggle, that continues to suffer.
sentences.zh: 他们仍在挣扎，仍在受苦。

sentences.en: And so our context is a little bit different.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的背景有点不同。

sentences.en: Because in reality, these are simply not analogous societies.
sentences.zh: 因为实际上，这些社会根本无法类比。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: For a lot of Black South Africans to see Afrikaners being labeled as the persecuted people in their society,
sentences.zh: 对于许多南非黑人来说，看到阿非利卡人被贴上社会受迫害群体的标签，

sentences.en: it just is shocking and flies in the face of their reality, as they describe it.
sentences.zh: 这简直令人震惊，且与他们所描述的现实背道而驰。

sentences.en: A lot of Black South Africans will say, you know, life here continues to be very difficult.
sentences.zh: 许多南非黑人会说，你知道，这里的生活依然非常艰难。

sentences.en: Unemployment is very high.
sentences.zh: 失业率非常高。

sentences.en: Crime is really bad.
sentences.zh: 犯罪问题非常严重。

sentences.en: When people do find jobs, you know, the wages aren't very good.
sentences.zh: 当人们找到工作时，工资也不高。

sentences.en: They don't have stable housing.
sentences.zh: 他们没有稳定的住房。

sentences.en: So the truth is, a lot of Black South Africans, if they had a chance to go to the U.S.'s refugees, they probably would love to take up that offer.
sentences.zh: 所以事实是，许多南非黑人如果有机会以难民身份去美国，他们很可能会乐意接受这个提议。

sentences.en: But there is no such offer.
sentences.zh: 但根本没有这样的提议。

sentences.en: But there is no such offer.
sentences.zh: 但根本没有这样的提议。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of Black South Africans, they feel that for the Trump administration, this is not about how much someone is suffering,
sentences.zh: 我认为许多南非黑人觉得，对于特朗普政府来说，这与某人受苦的程度无关，

sentences.en: but it's about the type of person they want in their country.
sentences.zh: 而与他们想要什么样的人进入他们的国家有关。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And thanks, ladies and gentlemen, for coming out here this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 也感谢各位女士、各位先生今天下午的到来。

sentences.en: And as the deputy secretary of state said when the Afrikaners arrived,
sentences.zh: 正如副国务卿在阿非利卡人抵达时所说，

sentences.en: This would be in the interest of the United States.
sentences.zh: 这符合美国的利益。

sentences.en: Some of the criteria are making sure that refugees did not pose any challenge to our national security and that they could be assimilated easily into our country.
sentences.zh: 其中一些标准是确保难民不会对我们的国家安全构成任何挑战，并且他们可以轻松融入我们的国家。

sentences.en: He said that they feel that they will assimilate well in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他说他们觉得这些人能很好地融入美国。

sentences.en: And ultimately, that makes it no longer about, you know, persecution, but about who fits the image that this administration wants to see in the country.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这不再是关于迫害，而是关于谁符合本届政府希望在国家中看到的形象。

sentences.en: We wish them well.
sentences.zh: 我们祝愿他们一切顺利。

sentences.en: We welcome these people to the United States and to a new future.
sentences.zh: 我们欢迎这些人来到美国，开启新的未来。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And that image is somebody who's white.
sentences.zh: 而那个形象就是白人。

sentences.en: Somebody who's white.
sentences.zh: 就是白人。

sentences.en: Well, John, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，约翰，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Sunday, Israel began extensive ground operations in Gaza involving tens of thousands of soldiers.
sentences.zh: 周日，以色列在加沙开始了大规模地面行动，涉及数万名士兵。

sentences.en: Officials said the operation has multiple objectives.
sentences.zh: 官员们表示，此次行动有多个目标。

sentences.en: To force Hamas to release the dozens of Israeli hostages that it still holds.
sentences.zh: 迫使哈马斯释放其仍扣押的数十名以色列人质。

sentences.en: To pressure the group into a new ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 向该组织施压以达成新的停火协议。

sentences.en: Or to force it to finally surrender.
sentences.zh: 或者迫使其最终投降。

sentences.en: Israeli officials said that the new campaign will be carried out gradually in stages and that it could be stopped at any moment if a deal is reached with Hamas.
sentences.zh: 以色列官员表示，新的军事行动将分阶段逐步进行，如果与哈马斯达成协议，随时可以停止。

sentences.en: And former President Joe Biden has been diagnosed with metastatic prostate cancer, an aggressive form of the disease that has now spread to his bones.
sentences.zh: 前总统乔·拜登被诊断出患有转移性前列腺癌，这是一种已扩散至骨骼的侵袭性疾病。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Nina Feldman, Mary Wilson, Shannon Lynn, and Sidney Harper.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由尼娜·费尔德曼、玛丽·威尔逊、香农·林和西德尼·哈珀制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by M.J.
sentences.zh: 由M.J.

sentences.en: Davis Lynn and Lexi Diao.
sentences.zh: 戴维斯·林和莱克西·刁编辑。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Alicia Baetube, Roe Nemisto, Marian Lozano, and Pat McCusker.
sentences.zh: 包含艾丽西亚·巴图贝、罗·内米斯托、玛丽安·洛萨诺和帕特·麦卡斯克创作的原创音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由克里斯·伍德进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderland.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderland的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会睡得不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean what kind of light do they require because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 我是指他们需要什么样的光线，因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
